_about: Tower weapons and their upgrades at the Tower smithy ("Level GR Weapons"), written by dev/make-tower-weapons.py. Per weapon: its line per stat; gain[i] and points[i] are what level i + 1 adds and uses (attack, element and status in the game's raw units, the true values; attack is shown x the type's displayFactor / 100, element and status x 10: the game prints them with a 0 after the value, mhfo-hd.dll 0x1098d620), cost rows [first level, last level, [[item, qty]]] (0-based) pay for each level in that range. Status has a column per status sigil; a Shelling Level gain of 3 is one step along shells (the Gunlance shell names). budget = the most points a weapon takes. shops: the live shop rows of each material [source, currency, price, qty, rank gate]. sharpView: the weapon panel shows a melee weapon's sharpness bar only up to base + step x min(full, sharpStart + the Sharpness levels' gain) on the 0-400 scale and covers the rest in black (mhfo-hd.dll 0x1098f740); sharpStart is the weapon record's byte +0x09. skyGems: Courage, Glittering and Divine Gems a tower clear pays on average per District (hvmhfz_re data/tower_gem_payout.tsv).
